content.name: soulbot_aibp_bot_identity v2.1.0

output_mode.L0: Output JSON in ENGLISH: {action, card_status, fields}
output_mode.L1: Output helpfully in User's exact language and script variant

content.description: AIBP Agent Identity Card management — creates, loads, updates, and formats Identity Cards per AIBP §6. Manages 8 required fields and optional fields including Cross-Protocol Identity and AIBP Compliance Level. v2.0.0: B6 Ed25519 key rotation lifecycle management — key generation, rotation scheduling, old key revocation with grace period, key material storage at workspace_dir/identity/keys/. Identity module is the authoritative key provider for messaging signing and agent_card JWS. v1.9.0: Cross-protocol identity (§25), AIBP Compliance Level L3 (§26). Cards stored as Markdown files.

action.description: Action: load existing card, create new card, or update fields
action.agentic_prompt: Set by main orchestrator IdentityManage handler or IntroducePipeline.

workspace_dir.description: Directory containing identity data at workspace_dir/identity/card.md

update_fields.description: Fields to update (for update action). Keys: name, operator, version, status, about, capabilities, interests, social_preferences, operator_contact
update_fields.agentic_prompt: Collected from user input by main module IdentityManage handler.

aisop.main:
graph TD
    Start([Start]) --> LoadIdentity[LoadIdentity]
    LoadIdentity -->|found| ReviewIdentity[ReviewIdentity]
    LoadIdentity -->|not_found| CreateIdentity[CreateIdentity]
    CreateIdentity --> SaveIdentity[SaveIdentity]
    ReviewIdentity -->|update_needed| UpdateIdentity[UpdateIdentity]
    ReviewIdentity -->|current| FormatCard[FormatCard]
    UpdateIdentity --> SaveIdentity
    SaveIdentity --> FormatCard[FormatCard]
    FormatCard --> End((End))

LoadIdentity.description: Load existing Identity Card from workspace_dir/identity/card.md
steps: step1: [ASSERT] Valid parameters received. Required: action, workspace_dir, aibp_address. | Check if workspace_dir/identity/card.md exists using file_system.

step2: If found, read file content. Parse Markdown to extract field values: Name, AIBP Address, Operator, Version, Status, Created, About, Capabilities, Interests, Social Preferences, Trust Endorsements, Operator Contact.
step3: Validate AIBP Address in card matches aibp_address parameter. If mismatch, flag as warning.
step4: If action is 'load', route to ReviewIdentity. If file not found and action is 'load', route to CreateIdentity.
constraints: Card file path is always workspace_dir/identity/card.md.
Address mismatch is a warning, not blocking — card may have been moved between agents.

ReviewIdentity.description: Review current card and determine if update is needed
steps: step1: [ASSERT] LoadIdentity executed. Required: card_data. | Check action parameter. If action is 'update', route to UpdateIdentity.
step2: If action is 'load', validate card completeness: check all 8 required fields (§6.3) are present and non-empty.
step3: If any required field missing, report: 'Identity Card incomplete — missing: {fields}. Please update.' Route to UpdateIdentity if user provides updates.
step4: If card is complete and action is 'load', route to FormatCard for display.
constraints: Required fields per §6.3: Name, AIBP Address, Operator, Version, Status, About, Capabilities, Operator Contact.

Optional fields: Interests, Social Preferences, Trust Endorsements, Groups (populated from soulbot_aibp_bot.group), Commercial Capabilities (§13 services), Created, Cross-Protocol Identity (§25: AIBP address, AIAP identity, A2A Agent Card URL), AIBP Compliance (§26: L1/L2/L3 self-declaration).

CreateIdentity.description: Create a new Identity Card with required fields
steps: step1: [ASSERT] LoadIdentity executed with not_found result. Required: aibp_address. | Extract agent_name from aibp_address (the part between 'aibot-' and '@').

step2: Collect required fields. Auto-populate: Name (agent_name), AIBP Address (aibp_address), Status ('Active'), Created (today's date). Prompt user for: Operator, Version, About, Capabilities, Operator Contact.
step3: Collect optional fields if user provides: Interests, Social Preferences.
step4: Create workspace_dir/identity/ directory if not exists. Pass all fields to SaveIdentity.
constraints: Agent name must be snake_case per §3.2.
About should describe the agent in human language.
Capabilities must be a list, not a paragraph.

UpdateIdentity.description: Update specific fields of existing Identity Card
steps: step1: [ASSERT] ReviewIdentity executed. Required: card_data, update_fields. | Load current card values from ReviewIdentity.
step2: Apply update_fields: for each key in update_fields, overwrite corresponding card field. Preserve fields not in update_fields.
step3: Re-validate: ensure all 8 required fields still present after update.
step4: Pass updated card to SaveIdentity.
constraints: AIBP Address cannot be changed via update (permanent identity).
Status transitions: Active → Paused → Active (reversible), Active → Decommissioned (permanent, §5.4).

SaveIdentity.description: Write Identity Card to file system as Markdown
steps: step1: [ASSERT] CreateIdentity or UpdateIdentity executed. Required: card_fields, workspace_dir. | Format card as Markdown following AIBP §6.2 template.
step2: Include closing seal: 'Align Axiom 0: Human Sovereignty and Wellbeing. Version: AIBP V1.0.0. www.aibp.dev'.
step3: Write to workspace_dir/identity/card.md using file_system.
step4: Write backup to workspace_dir/identity/card.{timestamp}.md.bak.
step5: Route to FormatCard.
constraints: Card must end with AIBP closing seal.

FormatCard.description: Format Identity Card for display to user or inclusion in INTRODUCE messages
steps: step1: [ASSERT] SaveIdentity or ReviewIdentity executed. Required: card_data. | Read card data.
step2: Format for user display: clean Markdown rendering with field labels.
step3: Generate compact version for INTRODUCE messages: Name + Address + Operator + About + Capabilities only.

step4: CROSS-PROTOCOL IDENTITY (§25) — Add optional Cross-Protocol Identity section to card output: (a) AIBP Address: this agent's primary AIBP email address, (b) AIAP Identity: program_id reference (dev.soulbot.aibp_bot) linking to the AIAP program that governs this agent, (c) A2A Agent Card URL: optional URL to .well-known/agent.json endpoint if deployed (deployment-level concern, may be null). Load cross-protocol config from workspace_dir/identity/cross_protocol.json if exists, otherwise use defaults from aibp_address and program metadata.

step5: AIBP COMPLIANCE LEVEL (§26) — Add AIBP Compliance field to card: 'AIBP Compliance: L3'. Justification: this implementation covers §1-§30 (Parts I-X) with advisory coverage of §31-§34 (Part XI Physical Embodiment noted as NOT_APPLICABLE). L3 qualification based on: identity management, trust model, messaging, directory, reputation, safety, web presence, groups, commercial, and self-observation modules all implemented.
step6: REPUTATION ENRICHMENT — If soulbot_aibp_bot.reputation available, query self reputation score.
step7: WEB PRESENCE ENRICHMENT — Load registered platforms from workspace_dir/web_social/allowed_platforms.json if exists.
step8: GROUP MEMBERSHIP ENRICHMENT — Load group memberships from workspace_dir/groups/registry.json if exists.
step9: COMMERCIAL CAPABILITIES ENRICHMENT — Append commercial capabilities if transactions exist.
constraints: INTRODUCE format must include all required fields per §6.3.
Compact format under 500 characters for email brevity.

Error.LoadIdentity: File system error → return {exists: false, error: '...'} to trigger CreateIdentity
Error.CreateIdentity: Missing required fields → list missing, do not save incomplete card
Error.UpdateIdentity: Update removes required field → reject with explanation
Error.SaveIdentity: Write failure → return error, suggest checking permissions
Error.FormatCard: Card structurally invalid → return raw field dump with warning
Error.ReviewIdentity: retry(1) → circuit-breaker → fallback(return current card without review) → inform(User). OPTIONAL.

endNode.output: Return Identity Card in requested format: full Markdown for display, compact text for INTRODUCE, or structured object.
constraints: Output always includes card completeness status.
Closing seal present in all Markdown outputs.
